sources.summary: A rest area where clusters of trees leading into a quiet forest are interwoven with small yet unique man-made structures. The entire site also serves as a dining space, with food trucks and tables arranged throughout, drawing many visitors in search of shade. However, alongside accessible facilities such as restrooms, an information center, and lounges, there are also many restricted-use spaces including a first-aid station, a police booth, and a telecommunications equipment room.
